title: Azure DevOps | MID
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Azure DevOps | MID em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Projetar e implementar soluções de infraestrutura em Azure, garantindo alta disponibilidade, escalabilidade e segurança;
  • Desenvolver arquiteturas avançadas com foco em contêineres e orquestração utilizando Kubernetes;
  • Colaborar com times de desenvolvimento, operações e segurança na construção de soluções integradas;
  • Avaliar e recomendar tecnologias e ferramentas adequadas para desafios de infraestrutura;
  • Realizar análises de performance e propor otimizações em sistemas e aplicações;
  • Documentar arquiteturas, soluções e boas práticas operacionais;
  • Atuar no suporte técnico durante implementação e pós-implementação;
  • Liderar iniciativas de automação de infraestrutura utilizando Terraform, Ansible e scripts personalizados.



Requisitos e qualificações


  • Experiência comprovada em arquitetura de soluções com foco em infraestrutura Azure;
  • Sólido conhecimento em serviços Azure, como: Azure Storage (Blob, File, Queue), Azure Networking (VNETs, Subnets, NSG, UDR, VPN Gateway, Application Gateway), Azure Service Bus e Event Grid e Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS);
  • Experiência com automação utilizando PowerShell, Azure CLI ou ferramentas similares;
  • Vivência em gerenciamento e orquestração de contêineres com Kubernetes e Istio;
  • Conhecimento avançado em redes e service mesh;
  • Experiência com práticas de DevOps e CI/CD (Jenkins, GitLab CI, Azure Pipelines);
  • Experiência na construção de soluções resilientes, com alta disponibilidade e tolerância a falhas;
  • Forte habilidade em troubleshooting e resolução de problemas complexos;
  • Boa comunicação, capacidade de apresentação e atuação colaborativa em equipe.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior DevOps Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are seeking a full-time, remote Senior DevOps Engineer with 5+ years of experience of cloud and DevOps experience to join the core team of our U.S. client. In this role, you will work on both our client's and their clients' software products bridging the gap between development and operations. You will do so by leveraging your expertise in cloud technologies and DevOps principles to design, build, deploy, and manage cloud infrastructure and applications.

Our client is a venture studio that surrounds industry subject matter experts with senior technical talent to build AI-native software solving real-world problems as well as consulting services to propel software companies along their AI journey.


Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines
  • Develop and implement automated CI/CD workflows
  • Partner with engineering and data teams to operationalize AI/ML models, services, and applications in production environments
  • Establish best practices for infrastructure as code (IaC), observability, reliability, and security
  • Build frameworks and tooling to streamline feature release velocity while maintaining system stability and compliance
  • Evaluate and integrate emerging AI tooling (e.g., code generation, testing automation, AIOps) into DevOps workflows
  • Optimize cloud resource utilization and cost efficiency across distributed systems
  • Lead incident response, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement of system resilience
  • Advise on DevOps maturity, cloud architecture, and AI-enabled engineering practices


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication and teamwork skills
  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, or Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) roles
  • Strong expertise in cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, or Azure) and cloud-native architectures
  • Proven experience building and managing CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, ArgoCD)
  • Deep knowledge of containerization and orchestration (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code tools (e.g., Terraform, AWS CloudFormation)
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, CodeWhisperer, LLM APIs) and their integration into workflows
  • Strong scripting/programming skills (e.g., Python, Bash)
  • Solid understanding of monitoring, logging, and observability tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog)
  • Experience with security best practices in cloud and DevOps environments (e.g., IAM, secrets management, compliance)
  • Ability to design systems that balance delivery speed with reliability and governance
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to work across engineering, product, and executive stakeholders
  • Proven ability to stay self-motivated, work hard, own problems from start to finish, and deliver in a vibrant, fast-moving environment
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently or as part of a broader team.
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • University degree in a technical field
  • Experience with AWS


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and your national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: HubSpot Administrator
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para HubSpot Administrator em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

HubSpot Administrator


Location : Remote (Brazil)



About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong teams across technology, operations, and customer-facing functions. Our trusted technology partner is seeking a HubSpot Administrator to support and optimise its HubSpot ecosystem across marketing, sales, and service operations.


Position Overview


We are seeking an experienced HubSpot Administrator to support daily HubSpot operations, maintain system efficiency, optimise workflows, and ensure the platform supports business objectives. This role requires a proactive, detail-oriented professional who can manage CRM processes, integrations, reporting, and automation while supporting cross-functional teams.


Key Responsibilities


Daily HubSpot Administration

  • Maintain data quality across Marketing, Sales, and Service hubs
  • Manage user permissions, onboarding, and access controls
  • Perform data cleanup, duplicate management, and system maintenance
  • Monitor integrations and troubleshoot connectivity issues
  • Maintain pipelines, deal stages, and custom properties
  • Respond to internal HubSpot-related requests via Slack


Workflow & Automation

  • Create and optimise workflows for lead nurturing and sales processes
  • Build and maintain email templates, sequences, and campaigns
  • Configure lead scoring and qualification criteria
  • Manage dashboards and custom reporting


Data Management & Strategic Support

  • Ensure CRM data integrity and accurate field mapping
  • Generate reports for sales, marketing, and leadership teams
  • Maintain process and system documentation
  • Collaborate with teams to improve processes and HubSpot usage
  • Train team members on workflows and new features
  • Stay updated on HubSpot best practices and functionality


Required Qualifications

  • 1+ years of hands-on HubSpot administration experience
  • Experience with HubSpot workflows, automations, and CRM management
  • Familiarity with APIs, integrations, and data migration
  • Strong understanding of CRM and marketing automation best practices
  • Analytical and detail-oriented mindset
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills


Preferred Qualifications

  • HubSpot certifications preferred
  • Experience with Zapier or similar automation tools
  • Basic HTML/CSS knowledge for email customisation
  • Previous SaaS or B2B experience is a plus


What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation
  • Fully remote work environment
  • Opportunity to work with modern SaaS platforms and automation tools
  • High-impact role supporting business operations and systems strategy
  • Collaborative and fast-growing environment with strong ownership.

title: .NET/C# SR
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para .NET/C# SR em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

.NET/C# - React (Fullstack)

Brazil

Senior Software Engineer


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home



Job Summary


As a .NET/C# and React Engineer, you will make a significant contribution to our platform's evolution by developing innovative features and ensuring its ongoing stability through close collaboration with a cross-functional team. This role is responsible for contributing to the full software development lifecycle, from concept and design to deployment and maintenance, while upholding high standards for code quality and performance. You will play a fundamental part in delivering a robust and scalable user experience, working in a supportive, team-oriented environment alongside other engineers and product stakeholders to bring new capabilities to life.



Responsibilities and Duties


  • Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable software applications, ensuring code is clean, performant, and adheres to high-quality standards;
  • Work closely with multidisciplinary teams—including Product, QA, and UX—in agile settings to deliver resilient solutions that support strategic business objectives;
  • Actively participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and propose architectural improvements to optimize platform performance and reliability;
  • Provide technical guidance to other engineers on the team, promoting best development practices and contributing to team growth.


Essential Skills


  • Experience with the .NET/C# ecosystem for backend development and React for frontend in cloud-based (SaaS) environments;
  • Strong understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and agile methodologies such as Scrum and Kanban.



Highly Desirable Skills


  • Experience with AWS cloud platform (preferred), microservices architecture, and container technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes;
  • Deep knowledge of SQL and database design for both relational and non-relational systems (Postgres, MongoDB);
  • Familiarity with building and maintaining continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD) pipelines and DevOps practices;
  • Knowledge or hands-on experience with the Angular framework for frontend development;
  • Experience with IDM (Identity Management).



About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Advanced After Effects YouTube Video Editor
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Advanced After Effects YouTube Video Editor em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

⚠️ IMPORTANT: In order to apply, complete the test in After Effects (99% won't do it)! Copy and paste this link into your browser to get started:



If you just use LinkedIn's \"Easy Apply\" you will not be considered for this role.


Overview:

We are 100C ( an 8-person YouTube agency based in the United States that creates and grows YouTube channels for business owners. We need a new ADVANCED YouTube editor experienced in After Effects to take over for one of our well-established clients.


About the role:

We do all of our video editing (except for color grading and sound) in After Effects, so we’re looking for a video editor who is skilled with the software. Your role will be handling all the video editing for one of our well-established clients. Your job will include everything necessary to make professional YouTube videos, such as:

  • Color grading
  • Trimming
  • Audio post production
  • Planning the appropriate visuals for each video
  • Finding footage and imagery that match our clients’ branding
  • Using AI effectively to generate custom visuals
  • Laying out media
  • Importing and using motion graphic templates
  • Creating custom animations
  • Creating AI avatars (we'll show you how)
  • Finding and editing appropriate music
  • Finding and editing appropriate sound effects
  • Strategic editing (understanding what to cut, what to include, and how to structure it for maximum engagement)


Here is a reel of our work to give you an idea of the type of video editing we do:


Our Values:

It's important that you are in alignment with our values. If this doesn't sound like you, do NOT apply:


  • Quality First - We are a PREMIUM agency, so it's important that you're driven to constantly do your best work and take your skills to the next level. If you're just looking for a job that is easy to do and doesn't require you to think carefully about your editing, this role is NOT for you.


  • High Accountability - You want to take responsibility for your successes AND your failures. If we call you out for doing poor-quality work or delivering late, you have the emotional maturity to take ownership for it and use that to drive you to do better next time.


  • Directness - We don't beat around the bush. If you do great work, we praise you and let you know. Similarly, if something is bad, we tell you it's bad. If you can't take direct criticism, this role is NOT for you.


  • Independence - You are good at solving your own problems. We are here to help, and will go out of our way to train you and make you feel comfortable in your role, but you should be eager to own this position and do it well without us needing to constantly push you.


Additional Requirements:

Below is a list of additional requirements for the job, please read through it carefully before applying:

  • Advanced English proficiency
  • Available the equivalent of full-time (at least 40 hours per week)
  • Willing to work on weekends when necessary
  • Available to start within the next two weeks
  • Advanced After Effects skills: 3D, Rotoscoping, Masking, Motion tracking, Keying, Expressions
  • Have a “design eye”: the ability to create and follow aesthetic branding guidelines
  • Professional, meaning you deliver professional-grade work on time
  • Highly responsive


The Offer:

If hired, we will provide free copies of all the plugins we use ($500 in tools), pay for your Magnific (formerly Freepik) and Envato accounts, and teach you how to edit videos in After Effects the same way we do.


Your starting pay will be $1,500-$2,500USD per month depending on your skill level. Once you show us that you can complete the work without needing much feedback, we will increase your monthly base by $500USD. You can also earn a performance bonus of $500USD every month. So you have potential to be making as much as $3,500USD/mo within months of starting (if you're good).


The Test:

In order to evaluate candidates, we have developed a test of your After Effects video editing skills, below are instructions and links to all the files you will need to complete it:


⚠️ In order to apply, please copy and paste the link below into your browser to take a quick test in After Effects. It includes all the materials you will need to complete it, along with step-by-step instructions:



If you just use LinkedIn's \"Easy Apply\" you will not be considered for this role.


The deadline to submit your finished video is Friday, May 29th. If your submission is good, we will reach out to schedule an interview. If you have any questions about the test, the position, or our company, please contact Cyan on Linkedin or email him here:

description:

Python SR (Azure)


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Job Summary


We are looking for a skilled Python Developer to join our team, with proven experience in building reliable applications in Azure environments. The ideal candidate will also have hands-on knowledge of Infrastructure as Code and be familiar with core Azure services such as Virtual Networks (VNet), Virtual Machines (VMs), Role-Based Access Control (RBAC).   • Agile & DevOps Mindset – Experience working in Agile teams, advocating for DevOps best practices, and continuously improving infrastructure.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Experience with AWS.

Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies.   • Conhecimento em Analytics.


Habilidades comportamentais

  • Comunicação clara e assertiva;
  • Capacidade de interação com públicos técnicos e não técnicos;
  • Habilidade para defender decisões arquiteturais e conduzir negociações técnicas;
  • Visão sistêmica e pensamento estratégico;
  • Perfil colaborativo, com foco em mentoria e compartilhamento de conhecimento;
  • Proatividade, organização e senso de responsabilidade;
  • Orientação à qualidade, eficiência e resultados.

We equip our team with proprietary and external AI-driven tools to design and build digital-native platforms, integrating cutting-edge technologies and enabling companies to innovate, transform their businesses, and drive success in their markets.

title: Liquidity Partnership Manager (LATAM)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Liquidity Partnership Manager (LATAM) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview

We are looking for an LP Partnership Manager to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across key regions. This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution.

The ideal candidate is highly connected within the local market, with a strong network of liquidity providers and a deep understanding of regional payment and banking landscapes.


Key Responsibilities

Business Development & Partnerships

  • Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers
  • Evaluate LP quality (pricing, depth, reliability, regions covered)
  • Negotiate trading terms (spreads, fees, credit lines, margin terms)


Market & Network Development

  • Leverage existing network to expand LP coverage in key regions (APAC, LATAM, Africa)
  • Maintain strong relationships with banks, payment providers, and liquidity partners
  • Stay up to date with local market dynamics, pricing trends, and competitive landscape


Execution & Collaboration

  • Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, and execution quality
  • Coordinate with internal teams to onboard LPs and ensure smooth operational setup
  • Support ongoing performance monitoring and optimization of LP relationships


Banking & Infrastructure Setup

  • Facilitate opening of bank accounts and payment rails required for LP operations
  • Identify suitable partners to support local currency flows and settlement


Requirements

  • 5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, or liquidity management
  • Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, or related financial services
  • Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, and payment partners
  • Proven ability to source and onboard LPs in local markets
  • Strong understanding of regional market structures and liquidity dynamics
  • Must have strong, deep LP network in at least one of the following regions: LATAM


Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Customer Success Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Success Specialist em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


As a Customer Success Specialist, you will help professors at leading universities in the US integrate JoVE videos into their courses to improve teaching outcomes and student success. You'll play a key role in ensuring users get the most value from their JoVE subscription.



Please share your resume in English.



Responsibilities:


  • Conduct daily outreach to Faculty (via calls, emails, and 1:1 demos) to set up JoVE integrations in courses and increase product usage.
  • Increase JoVE adoption by delivering product awareness sessions across existing customer universities and research institutes.
  • Grow engagement and usage by delivering presentations at (1) exhibits and conferences, (2) university seminars and workshops, and (3) onsite customer visits.
  • Strengthen subscription renewal outcomes by ensuring smooth implementation support, and consistent usage of JoVE resources.
  • Influence product decisions by communicating customer feedback to sales, product, and marketing teams.


Requirements:


  • A master's degree or PhD in Life Science disciplines.
  • Experience in science communications, academic outreach or other customer-facing roles is preferred.
  • Fluent communication skills English.
  • Knowledge of education, market trends, and challenges in assigned content areas i.e. Biology, Chemistry, Medicine, Physics, Engineering, or Psychology.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with a passion for remote relationship-building.
  • Experience in networking using cold calling is preferred.

  • Conduzir estudos e provas de conceito em soluções de IA, com foco em viabilidade e valor
  • Acompanhar tendências tecnológicas e seu impacto nos produtos e na estratégia da empresa

  • Arquitetura de Software moderna (microservices, event-driven, hexagonal, Domain-Driven Design, Dados e IA).

Assistência Médica

description:

Na Bluesoft, valorizamos o bem-estar de nossos colaboradores, pois acreditamos que um ambiente de trabalho positivo resulta em um trabalho extraordinário que mantém nossos clientes sempre satisfeitos.

Integridade: Valorizamos as pessoas e agimos com ética e transparência para conquistar credibilidade e confiança.

Eficácia: Acreditamos em fazer a coisa certa, do jeito certo e rápido.

Engajamento: Na Bluesoft, atuamos com energia, buscamos a excelência e assumimos a responsabilidade coletiva para crescer juntos e alcançar grandes resultados.

Evolução: Estamos sempre buscando ser melhores a cada dia. Valorizamos a humildade e a aprendizagem contínua, e incentivamos a criatividade e a inovação.

Se você é um(a) desenvolvedor(a) Java experiente , com mais de 5 anos de prática e domínio de Java 8+ , esta vaga pode ser ideal para você.

Buscamos profissionais com base técnica sólida, espírito colaborativo e interesse em crescimento contínuo, que gostem de resolver problemas complexos e atuar em sistemas de alta criticidade.


Aqui na Bluesoft, a Inteligência Artificial já faz parte do desenvolvimento de software . Utilizamos ferramentas como OpenCode integradas ao fluxo de engenharia para acelerar tarefas, apoiar decisões técnicas e aumentar a produtividade.

  • AWS como infraestrutura principal

title: Power BI Developer – Fabric
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Power BI Developer – Fabric em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Power BI Developer – Fabric


About Pyxus


We are a global company with more than 150 years of history, committed to creating a better-growing world. Our mission is to produce high-quality products and ingredients through sustainable practices, ensuring social, environmental, and production traceability, while promoting the well-being of farmers and the communities we serve.

As part of the Pyxus group, Alliance One Brasil shares this vision, and we believe in a future where people are inspired to achieve excellence, communities are strengthened by trust and innovation, and value is created through a commitment to serve. Our culture is built on resilience, accountability, encouragement, and transparency, and we value each team member for their experience, knowledge, and passion.

Join Pyxus and help us grow a better world together!


Job Scope

Leads the operation and maintenance of Microsoft Power BI solutions using Azure Cloud data services. This role will support enterprise data reporting and validate data sets for use by the business using a data lake medallion architecture.Supports the daily reporting based on the Power BI environment for the enterprise.

This is a fully remote position.

The role is focused on providing support to the Morrisville, NC (USA) unit.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design and deploy production ready BI and Analytic solutions
  • Active role in data models, tools, processes, project assessment and development process design for the Power BI Environment.
  • Provide technical overviews and tool demonstrations to BI Power Users, Key Business users and Functional owners, communicating technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Diagnose and resolve application bottlenecks and performance issues.
  • Diagnose and resolve production support issues with the Power BI environment.
  • Work closely with Key Business users to understand their challenges and translate them into requirements.
  • Organize, create and maintain critical technical and functional documentation for solutions, including best practices, technical specifications, test plans and training materials.
  • Apply Data Level Security for Power BI solutions
  • Ensure Data Governance methods are applied to Power BI solutions.
  • Experience with SQL and relationship databases.
  • Support versioning, archiving, and deployment workflows Dev / Test / Prod environments
  • Lead the Power BI Community of Excellence (global team of citizen developers and analysts to drive innovation, uphold data governance, and deliver strategic insights)


Qualifications

  • Fluent English
  • BA/BS degree and experience in Information Technology
  • Proven success as a Power BI Developer in a multi-national organization using Power BI software and services.
  • Extensive Knowledge of Power BI, Data Analysis & Interpretation, SQL, Data Analysis Expressions (DAX) and communication/collaboration with stakeholders.
  • Hands on ETL/ELT tools, data integration, data pipelines, metadata tools, and database designs
  • Understanding and use of Python and R software (Preferred)
  • Proactive, great attention to detail, results-oriented problem solver
  • Ability to handle long-term goals along with immediate performance concerns.
  • Strong leadership skills with the ability to motivate and teach others.


Benefits

Profit-Sharing Program (PPR)

Health Insurance Plans

50% Medication Allowance

Mobile Phone Plan

Private Pension Plan

Meal Card

Employee Assistance Program – Mental Health and Well-being

Corporate Time Off Days

Wellhub

Group Life Insurance


Applications open until May 24, 2026.

title: Senior Technical Consultant – Front Arena
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Technical Consultant – Front Arena em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Why Zensar?

We’re a bunch of hardworking, fun-loving, people-oriented technology enthusiasts. We love what we do, and we’re passionate about helping our clients thrive in an increasingly complex digital world. Zensar is an organization focused on building relationships with our clients and with each other—and happiness is at the core of everything we do. In fact, we’re so into happiness that we’ve created a Global Happiness Council, and we send out a Happiness Survey to our employees each year. We’ve learned that employee happiness requires more than a competitive paycheck, and our employee value proposition—grow, own, achieve, learn (GOAL)—lays out the core opportunities we seek to foster for every employee. Teamwork and collaboration are critical to Zensar’s mission and success, and our teams work on a diverse and challenging mix of technologies across a broad industry spectrum. These industries include banking and financial services, high-tech and manufacturing, healthcare, insurance, retail, and consumer services. Our employees enjoy flexible work arrangements and a competitive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, 401(k), among other benefits. If you are looking for a place to have an immediate impact, to grow and contribute, where we work hard, play hard, and support each other, consider joining team Zensar!


Zensar is looking for a Senior Technical Consultant – Front Arena .


About the Role

The Senior Technical Consultant will act as the technical SME for the Front Arena implementation, responsible for overall technical design, integrations, and enabling delivery teams during both scoping and execution phases.


Key Responsibilities

Lead technical design for the Front Arena or Murex (MX.3B) or Calypso (Nasdaq) technical configuration (static data, environments) implementation

Own technical architecture, integrations, and system configuration approach

Support scoping activities, including defining technical complexity and risks

Act as technical SME to guide and upskill junior and partner consultants

Work closely with functional leads to ensure coherent front to back solutions

Support on site workshops as required


Required Skills & Experience

Spanish nice to have

Strong Front Arena technical expertise (configuration, architecture, integrations) or Murex (MX.3B) or Calypso (Nasdaq) technical configuration (static data, environments)

Experience with full front to back Front Arena implementations

Prior involvement in large scale / greenfield implementations

Ability to mentor and guide junior technical resources

Experience working in multi vendor delivery models

Spanish language skills strongly preferred

Experience in Latin American / Mexican market environments is a strong advantage,

Competent with Python


Zensar believes that diversity of backgrounds, thought, experience, and expertise fosters the robust exchange of ideas that enables the highest quality collaboration and work product. title: Liquidity Partnership Manager (LATAM)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Liquidity Partnership Manager (LATAM) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview

We are looking for an LP Partnership Manager to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across key regions. This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution.

The ideal candidate is highly connected within the local market, with a strong network of liquidity providers and a deep understanding of regional payment and banking landscapes.


Key Responsibilities

Business Development & Partnerships

  • Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers
  • Evaluate LP quality (pricing, depth, reliability, regions covered)
  • Negotiate trading terms (spreads, fees, credit lines, margin terms)


Market & Network Development

  • Leverage existing network to expand LP coverage in key regions (APAC, LATAM, Africa)
  • Maintain strong relationships with banks, payment providers, and liquidity partners
  • Stay up to date with local market dynamics, pricing trends, and competitive landscape


Execution & Collaboration

  • Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, and execution quality
  • Coordinate with internal teams to onboard LPs and ensure smooth operational setup
  • Support ongoing performance monitoring and optimization of LP relationships


Banking & Infrastructure Setup

  • Facilitate opening of bank accounts and payment rails required for LP operations
  • Identify suitable partners to support local currency flows and settlement


Requirements

  • 5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, or liquidity management
  • Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, or related financial services
  • Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, and payment partners
  • Proven ability to source and onboard LPs in local markets
  • Strong understanding of regional market structures and liquidity dynamics
  • Must have strong, deep LP network in at least one of the following regions: LATAM


Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Senior Oil & Gas Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Oil & Gas Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Location: Brazil (100% Remote)

Experience Level: Mid to Senior (5+ years)

Industry: Oil & Gas (Unconventional Onshore)


Role Summary

We are seeking a highly analytical Senior Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant to join our integrated Revenue team. The primary focus of this role is to ensure the integrity of severance tax reporting for Texas and Louisiana operations. You will be responsible for identifying, troubleshooting, and resolving reporting discrepancies that lead to state-issued penalties. This is a technical, hands-on role requiring deep experience in SAP PRA (CA/VL modules) and the ability to bridge the gap between transactional data and state regulatory compliance.


Responsibilities

  • Severance Tax Compliance : Lead the end-to-end severance tax reporting process for Texas and Louisiana, ensuring all volumes and values are reported accurately and timely to the respective state agencies.
  • Error Detection & Troubleshooting : Proactively identify reporting errors by comparing state-level data against internal production and valuation records. Utilize the Valuation Control Report (VCR) and specific SAP T-Codes to diagnose root causes of variances.
  • PPA Analysis : Analyze Prior Period Adjustments (PPAs) before posting to understand the ripple effect on the General Ledger (GL), production volumes, and pricing. Ensure all adjustments are justified and accurately reflected in amended filings.
  • Penalty Reduction : Serve as the lead in reducing state-issued penalties through meticulous data validation and the timely filing of amended returns (e.g., Texas G-10/P-5, Louisiana O3).
  • Process Improvement : Troubleshoot systemic process failures and, as needed, document standardized workflows to serve as guides for broader transactional teams.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Work as one team with the Revenue Accounting group to ensure that valuation formulas and owner payment setups are consistent with regulatory requirements.



Requirements

  • Minimum of 2 years of hands-on experience in the Check Input (CA) and Valuation (VL) modules. Must have experience booking company-operated revenues and navigating sub-ledger details.
  • At least 5+ years of experience, including experience in Upstream Oil & Gas accounting, ideally focused on unconventional, onshore assets.
  • Proven experience with US (ideally Texas and Louisiana )severance tax regulations, including high-cost gas exemptions and state disposition reporting.
  • Ability to perform deep-dive reconciliations across production, revenue, and tax data sets to identify complex transactional errors.
  • Advanced/Fluent English (written and spoken) is required for coordination with US-based stakeholders.
  • A diagnostic mindset - able to look at a reporting error and trace the logic back through the SAP PRA system to the source data.
  • Capable of managing complex reporting deadlines and independent research in a fully remote environment.


Technical Requirements

  • ERP: SAP PRA (CA, VL modules), S/4HANA (preferred).
  • Reporting Tools: Advanced Excel (Power Query/Pivot), Power BI, VCR Analysis.

title: Customer Success Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Success Specialist em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


As a Customer Success Specialist, you will help professors at leading universities in the US integrate JoVE videos into their courses to improve teaching outcomes and student success. You'll play a key role in ensuring users get the most value from their JoVE subscription.



Please share your resume in English.



Responsibilities:


  • Conduct daily outreach to Faculty (via calls, emails, and 1:1 demos) to set up JoVE integrations in courses and increase product usage.
  • Increase JoVE adoption by delivering product awareness sessions across existing customer universities and research institutes.
  • Grow engagement and usage by delivering presentations at (1) exhibits and conferences, (2) university seminars and workshops, and (3) onsite customer visits.
  • Strengthen subscription renewal outcomes by ensuring smooth implementation support, and consistent usage of JoVE resources.
  • Influence product decisions by communicating customer feedback to sales, product, and marketing teams.


Requirements:


  • A master's degree or PhD in Life Science disciplines.
  • Experience in science communications, academic outreach or other customer-facing roles is preferred.
  • Fluent communication skills English.
  • Knowledge of education, market trends, and challenges in assigned content areas i.e. Biology, Chemistry, Medicine, Physics, Engineering, or Psychology.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with a passion for remote relationship-building.
  • Experience in networking using cold calling is preferred.


Why Join JoVE?


  • You can expect compensation packages competitively placed within the local market.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and in improving student learning in science education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Desenvolvedor de Software Java Senior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor de Software Java Senior em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Na Bluesoft, valorizamos o bem-estar de nossos colaboradores, pois acreditamos que um ambiente de trabalho positivo resulta em um trabalho extraordinário que mantém nossos clientes sempre satisfeitos.


Temos uma missão clara: Prover tecnologia para tornar empresas mais ágeis e prósperas. Não apenas buscamos velocidade, mas também adaptabilidade e crescimento contínuo para gerar mais valor aos nossos clientes.


Nossa visão é ousada: Queremos ser a Melhor Empresa de sistemas de gestão do mundo! Acreditamos que é possível alcançar esse objetivo com nossa dedicação e comprometimento.


Nossos valores são o alicerce de tudo o que fazemos:


Integridade: Valorizamos as pessoas e agimos com ética e transparência para conquistar credibilidade e confiança.

Eficácia: Acreditamos em fazer a coisa certa, do jeito certo e rápido.

Engajamento: Na Bluesoft, atuamos com energia, buscamos a excelência e assumimos a responsabilidade coletiva para crescer juntos e alcançar grandes resultados.

Evolução: Estamos sempre buscando ser melhores a cada dia. Valorizamos a humildade e a aprendizagem contínua, e incentivamos a criatividade e a inovação.

Colaboração: Valorizamos a colaboração, o aprendizado mútuo e a união de forças para alcançar grandes conquistas, respeitando diferentes perspectivas e construindo, juntos, um futuro melhor.


Sobre a vaga


Se você é um(a) desenvolvedor(a) Java experiente , com mais de 5 anos de prática e domínio de Java 8+ , esta vaga pode ser ideal para você.

Buscamos profissionais com base técnica sólida, espírito colaborativo e interesse em crescimento contínuo, que gostem de resolver problemas complexos e atuar em sistemas de alta criticidade.


Aqui na Bluesoft, a Inteligência Artificial já faz parte do desenvolvimento de software . Utilizamos ferramentas como OpenCode integradas ao fluxo de engenharia para acelerar tarefas, apoiar decisões técnicas e aumentar a produtividade.

Nesse contexto, o papel do desenvolvedor evolui: além de escrever código, você irá revisar, supervisionar e refinar soluções geradas por IA , garantindo qualidade, arquitetura, segurança e aderência às regras de negócio.


Se você gosta de desafios técnicos e quer atuar em um ambiente de alta performance e inovação, estamos ansiosos para conhecer você!


Nosso ambiente de trabalho

  • Metodologias ágeis
  • AWS como infraestrutura principal
  • CI/CD com Jenkins, Sonar e Docker
  • Repositórios no GitHub
  • IntelliJ IDEA (Ultimate)
  • Linux remoto e Mac no escritório

Desafios que você vai encontrar


  • Processamento de milhões de registros em alto volume
  • Alta concorrência e performance crítica
  • Processamento assíncrono de jobs
  • Tuning e otimização de sistemas existentes
  • Análise de logs, profiling e troubleshooting
  • Evolução de uma base de código extensa sem quebrar o legado


Tecnologias que você vai usar no dia a dia

  • Java 21, Spring Boot, Spring MVC
  • Hibernate
  • Oracle e PostgreSQL
  • Redis
  • Vue.js, TypeScript, JavaScript
  • Git
  • JUnit 5, Mockito
  • Selenide
  • AWS, Docker, Jenkins, Sonar

Uso ocasional

  • PL/SQL
  • MongoDB 4.4
  • Ionic com Vue.js (mobile)


Legado (manutenção)

  • JSP
  • AngularJS
  • jQuery

  • Vue.js
  • Troubleshooting e análise de performance/logs
  • Otimização de SQL

  • Proficiency in proactive system health monitoring and performance tracking tools
  • Advanced/ Fluent English

description:

Python SR (Azure)


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


We are looking for a skilled Python Developer to join our team, with proven experience in building reliable applications in Azure environments. The ideal candidate will also have hands-on knowledge of Infrastructure as Code and be familiar with core Azure services such as Virtual Networks (VNet), Virtual Machines (VMs), Role-Based Access Control (RBAC). Experience in cloning and deploying services efficiently will be highly valued.

While the primary focus is on Azure, familiarity with AWS is considered a plus.

  • Disaster Recovery & Security – Develop automated backup strategies, define disaster recovery plans, and implement security best practices;
  • Workflow Automation & Integration – Build integrations to automate deployment processes, security checks, and operational workflows.

Essential Skills


  • Knowledgeable in Linux;

title: Advanced After Effects YouTube Video Editor
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Advanced After Effects YouTube Video Editor em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

⚠️ IMPORTANT: In order to apply, complete the test in After Effects (99% won't do it)! Copy and paste this link into your browser to get started:



If you just use LinkedIn's \"Easy Apply\" you will not be considered for this role.


Overview:

We are 100C ( an 8-person YouTube agency based in the United States that creates and grows YouTube channels for business owners. We need a new ADVANCED YouTube editor experienced in After Effects to take over for one of our well-established clients.


About the role:

We do all of our video editing (except for color grading and sound) in After Effects, so we’re looking for a video editor who is skilled with the software. Your role will be handling all the video editing for one of our well-established clients. Your job will include everything necessary to make professional YouTube videos, such as:

  • Color grading
  • Trimming
  • Audio post production
  • Planning the appropriate visuals for each video
  • Finding footage and imagery that match our clients’ branding
  • Using AI effectively to generate custom visuals
  • Laying out media
  • Importing and using motion graphic templates
  • Creating custom animations
  • Creating AI avatars (we'll show you how)
  • Finding and editing appropriate music
  • Finding and editing appropriate sound effects
  • Strategic editing (understanding what to cut, what to include, and how to structure it for maximum engagement)


Here is a reel of our work to give you an idea of the type of video editing we do:


Our Values:

It's important that you are in alignment with our values. If this doesn't sound like you, do NOT apply:


  • Quality First - We are a PREMIUM agency, so it's important that you're driven to constantly do your best work and take your skills to the next level. If you're just looking for a job that is easy to do and doesn't require you to think carefully about your editing, this role is NOT for you.


  • High Accountability - You want to take responsibility for your successes AND your failures. If we call you out for doing poor-quality work or delivering late, you have the emotional maturity to take ownership for it and use that to drive you to do better next time.


  • Directness - We don't beat around the bush. If you do great work, we praise you and let you know. Similarly, if something is bad, we tell you it's bad. If you can't take direct criticism, this role is NOT for you.


  • Independence - You are good at solving your own problems. We are here to help, and will go out of our way to train you and make you feel comfortable in your role, but you should be eager to own this position and do it well without us needing to constantly push you.


Additional Requirements:

Below is a list of additional requirements for the job, please read through it carefully before applying:

  • Advanced English proficiency
  • Available the equivalent of full-time (at least 40 hours per week)
  • Willing to work on weekends when necessary
  • Available to start within the next two weeks
  • Advanced After Effects skills: 3D, Rotoscoping, Masking, Motion tracking, Keying, Expressions
  • Have a “design eye”: the ability to create and follow aesthetic branding guidelines
  • Professional, meaning you deliver professional-grade work on time
  • Highly responsive


The Offer:

If hired, we will provide free copies of all the plugins we use ($500 in tools), pay for your Magnific (formerly Freepik) and Envato accounts, and teach you how to edit videos in After Effects the same way we do.


Your starting pay will be $1,500-$2,500USD per month depending on your skill level. Once you show us that you can complete the work without needing much feedback, we will increase your monthly base by $500USD. You can also earn a performance bonus of $500USD every month. So you have potential to be making as much as $3,500USD/mo within months of starting (if you're good).


The Test:

In order to evaluate candidates, we have developed a test of your After Effects video editing skills, below are instructions and links to all the files you will need to complete it:


⚠️ In order to apply, please copy and paste the link below into your browser to take a quick test in After Effects. It includes all the materials you will need to complete it, along with step-by-step instructions:



If you just use LinkedIn's \"Easy Apply\" you will not be considered for this role.


The deadline to submit your finished video is Friday, May 29th. If your submission is good, we will reach out to schedule an interview. If you have any questions about the test, the position, or our company, please contact Cyan on Linkedin or email him here:

title: Senior Python Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Python Engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company:


Windsor.ai has been founded in 2017 in Zürich, , we are growing fast. We connect data from 300+ sources (Facebook Ads, Google Ads, HubSpot, Salesforce, TikTok) to 30+ destinations (Looker Studio, Google Sheets, BigQuery, Snowflake, and LLMs like ChatGPT and Claude). Our customers include Puma, Audi, UBS, Asics and many more.


We are building a platform that makes it easy to connect any data source to any destination. There is more data being generated in the world every day, but the big problem is that the number of tools is also increasing so data must be updated in multiple systems and tools. We are solving this problem.


Role: We are looking for a Senior Python Engineer to join our team, focusing on Python services, API integrations, scalability, and production reliability.


Our Team:


Our team has around 30 people working remotely across Europe. We’re a highly technical team, and even our sales and marketing colleagues are comfortable writing at least some SQL. Our software engineers are specialised in backend with Python and frontend with React


Product:


We have built a data platform connecting to more than 300 different API’s. Big part of our work is dealing with all the complexity and variations in all the different API’s and scalability.


Technology:


We are mostly programming in python and using quite advanced features of python. Most common tools we use:


  • Python : flask, threads, pytest-xdist, pylint
  • Redis, postgres
  • Linux, docker
  • React, redux for frontend


Role Requirements:


  • 4+ years of programming experience.
  • Strong expertise in Python, with experience building and maintaining complex, production-grade systems
  • Good programming knowledge (OOP, mutable/immutable types etc.)
  • Solid experience working in Linux-based development and production environments
  • Enjoy working in a fast-moving organization where you can have a real impact
  • Fluency in English is mandatory


How we work:


We usually plan our work in two weeks intervals but the plan is not super strict so there might be some priorities changed during the sprint. We use Taiga, Gitlab, CI/CD lots of pytest and merge request reviews.


Location: Remote


Windsor.ai is a global team of data engineers and analysts who strive to make data integration effortless and insights easy to extract to everyone. We help businesses of all sizes connect their marketing and sales data, automate reporting, and measure what drives the greatest impact.

Requirements added by the job poster

• Accept a background check

• 4+ years of work experience with Python (Programming Language)

title: Desenvolvedor Python
description:

Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for a Senior Python Developer, who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will

Backend & APIs

  • Design and develop RESTful APIs in Python (FastAPI or Django REST Framework) to support workflows for registering operations and results.

AI Agents & LLMs

Data Engineering

  • Define data entities (opportunities, strategies, market parameters) to support continuous analysis.
  • Support the creation of dashboards and reports to assess strategic effectiveness.
  • Ensure data quality, consistency, and governance.


Mandatory Skills

  • +5 years of experience
  • Backend: Solid experience with Python (FastAPI, Flask, or Django).
  • Data: Experience with relational modeling, ETL/ELT pipelines, and advanced SQL.
  • AI: Experience integrating LLMs and agent frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen).
  • Architecture: Familiarity with REST API design and software best practices.
  • Infrastructure: Experience with PostgreSQL.
  • Language: Technical English for reading documentation.


Desirable Skills

  • Domain Knowledge: Experience in the electric power sector, free energy market, or trading.
  • Orchestration: Experience with Prefect, Airflow, or Temporal.
  • Vector Databases: Experience with Pinecone, Weaviate, or pgvector.
  • Observability: Experience monitoring applications and APIs (logs, metrics, tracing).
  • Community: Contributions to open‑source AI or Data projects.

title: Senior Technical Consultant – Front Arena
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Technical Consultant – Front Arena em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Why Zensar?

We’re a bunch of hardworking, fun-loving, people-oriented technology enthusiasts. We love what we do, and we’re passionate about helping our clients thrive in an increasingly complex digital world. Zensar is an organization focused on building relationships with our clients and with each other—and happiness is at the core of everything we do. In fact, we’re so into happiness that we’ve created a Global Happiness Council, and we send out a Happiness Survey to our employees each year. We’ve learned that employee happiness requires more than a competitive paycheck, and our employee value proposition—grow, own, achieve, learn (GOAL)—lays out the core opportunities we seek to foster for every employee. Teamwork and collaboration are critical to Zensar’s mission and success, and our teams work on a diverse and challenging mix of technologies across a broad industry spectrum. These industries include banking and financial services, high-tech and manufacturing, healthcare, insurance, retail, and consumer services. Our employees enjoy flexible work arrangements and a competitive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, 401(k), among other benefits. If you are looking for a place to have an immediate impact, to grow and contribute, where we work hard, play hard, and support each other, consider joining team Zensar!


Zensar is looking for a Senior Technical Consultant – Front Arena .


About the Role

The Senior Technical Consultant will act as the technical SME for the Front Arena implementation, responsible for overall technical design, integrations, and enabling delivery teams during both scoping and execution phases.


Key Responsibilities

Lead technical design for the Front Arena or Murex (MX.3B) or Calypso (Nasdaq) technical configuration (static data, environments) implementation

Own technical architecture, integrations, and system configuration approach

Support scoping activities, including defining technical complexity and risks

Act as technical SME to guide and upskill junior and partner consultants

Work closely with functional leads to ensure coherent front to back solutions

Support on site workshops as required


Required Skills & Experience

Spanish nice to have

Strong Front Arena technical expertise (configuration, architecture, integrations) or Murex (MX.3B) or Calypso (Nasdaq) technical configuration (static data, environments)

Experience with full front to back Front Arena implementations

Prior involvement in large scale / greenfield implementations

Ability to mentor and guide junior technical resources

Experience working in multi vendor delivery models

Spanish language skills strongly preferred

Experience in Latin American / Mexican market environments is a strong advantage,

Competent with Python


Zensar believes that diversity of backgrounds, thought, experience, and expertise fosters the robust exchange of ideas that enables the highest quality collaboration and work product. Zensar is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions shall be made without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other basis as protected by federal, state, or local law. Zensar is committed to providing veteran employment opportunities to our service men and women. Zensar is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for people with disabilities or religious observances, including reasonable accommodation when needed. Accommodation made to facilitate the recruiting process are not a guarantee of future or continued accommodation once hired.


All applicants must be legally authorized to work with Zensar. Visa sponsorship may be available for qualified applicants for certain positions.

title: Leadership trainer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Leadership trainer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About NIIT


NIIT provides comprehensive and scalable managed training services for learning administration that maps directly to our customer needs. Training is our business and passion. We are one of the largest training outsourcing providers in the world. NIIT delivers and administers 75,000 days of training each year, in 18 languages. We have designed and developed over 50,000 days of classroom training and 20,000 hours of web-based training localized to more than 25 languages. NIIT is a global service provider. We have a presence in more than 40 countries.



Link to our LinkedIn Page -

Link to our website -


Position: Leadership Trainer

Job Type - Freelance


Are you passionate about developing leaders and helping individuals excel in their careers? Do you possess a deep understanding of leadership theories, career development strategies, and practical techniques? If so, we have an exciting opportunity for you!


NIIT is a leading provider of professional development solutions, and we are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Leadership Skills Trainer to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will have the opportunity to make a significant impact by designing and delivering innovative training programs that empower individuals to reach their full leadership potential and accelerate their careers.


Responsibilities & Key Skills:


  • Deliver high-quality leadership skills training programs for professionals at various levels, from entry-level to executives.
  • Facilitate engaging and interactive training sessions using a variety of instructional techniques, including experiential learning, case studies, role-plays, and group exercises.
  • Creative Problem Solving
  • Agile Ways of Working
  • Influencing Skills for Leading Without Authority
  • Managerial and Leadership Skills
  • Leading team performance
  • Leading change


Qualifications:


  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Business, Psychology, Organizational Development).
  • Proven experience as a Leadership Skills Trainer, Career Coach, or related role, with a focus on leadership development and career advancement.
  • Strong knowledge of leadership theories, models, and best practices.
  • Excellent facilitation and presentation skills, with the ability to engage and inspire diverse audiences.
  • Ability to build rapport and establish credibility with individuals at all levels of an organization.
  • Strong coaching and mentoring skills, with the ability to provide constructive feedback and support individual growth.
  • Exceptional communication skills, both verbal and written.
  • Proactive, self-motivated, and able to work independently as well as part of a team.
  • Certification in leadership development, coaching, or related areas (e.g., CPLP, ICF, CTDP) is a plus.
  • 10+ years’ experience preferred
  • Language Requirements: Bilingual in local language (If Applicable) & English


If you are a dynamic and results-driven professional who thrives on helping others succeed, we would love to hear from you. Join our team and contribute to the growth and development of individuals and organizations through impactful leadership skills programs


NIIT is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic

title: Assistente de Suporte Técnico de TI
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Assistente de Suporte Técnico de TI em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Descrição da Vaga

Atuar na linha de frente do suporte, sendo o ponto focal para nossos usuários internos. O objetivo é garantir a continuidade dos negócios, assegurando que o ambiente de trabalho (físico e lógico) esteja sempre disponível e produtivo. Você será o guardião da experiência do usuário, tratando cada chamado com o senso de urgência e a qualidade que nossos clientes internos exigem.

Principais Responsabilidades

1. Operação e Atendimento (Sustentação)

  • Gestão de Chamados: Atuar no atendimento via sistemas de gestão (GLPI, Jira), respeitando rigorosamente os níveis de serviço (SLAs) e prazos de resolução.
  • Multicanalidade: Prestar suporte técnico ágil e eficiente através de diferentes vias: presencial, telefone, vídeo conferência e chats.
  • Manutenção de Hardware: Executar instalação, desinstalação, configuração e formatação de estações de trabalho (desktops/notebooks).
  • Manutenção Preventiva: Realizar a limpeza física e verificação de periféricos, incluindo impressoras e acessórios, garantindo a longevidade dos equipamentos e evitando falhas.

2. Infraestrutura e Software

  • Software: Instalação, atualização e suporte a softwares, com foco em Pacote Office 365 e sistemas legados/ERP (TOTVS).
  • Redes: Diagnóstico e suporte básico de conectividade (rede local, Wi-Fi e VPN).
  • Gestão de Inventário: Organizar e controlar o estoque de ativos (TI), garantindo a integridade dos equipamentos e auxiliando na gestão eficiente de recursos.

Requisitos Técnicos

  • Formação: Ensino Técnico em TI completo ou cursando/graduado em áreas correlatas (Sistemas de Informação, Redes, Ciência da Computação).
  • Domínio Técnico:
  • Experiência com ferramentas de chamados (GLPI, Jira).
  • Conhecimento prático em ERP (TOTVS) e ecossistema Microsoft (Windows/Office 365).
  • Vivência em montagem, configuração e manutenção física/lógica de computadores.
  • Noções básicas de redes (TCP/IP, impressoras, DNS).

Perfil Comportamental

  • Senso de Urgência & Organização: Entender que o tempo do usuário parado é um custo para a empresa; capacidade de priorizar demandas críticas.
  • Olhar de Dono: Zelo pelo patrimônio, cuidado com o estoque e proatividade para sugerir melhorias contínuas.
  • Comunicação Assertiva: Excelente escrita e fluência verbal para atendimento ao cliente.
  • Empatia: Capacidade de ouvir, compreender a frustração do usuário e prestar um atendimento humano e prestativo.

title: Customer Success Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Success Specialist em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


As a Customer Success Specialist, you will help professors at leading universities in the US integrate JoVE videos into their courses to improve teaching outcomes and student success. You'll play a key role in ensuring users get the most value from their JoVE subscription.



Please share your resume in English.



Responsibilities:


  • Conduct daily outreach to Faculty (via calls, emails, and 1:1 demos) to set up JoVE integrations in courses and increase product usage.
  • Increase JoVE adoption by delivering product awareness sessions across existing customer universities and research institutes.
  • Grow engagement and usage by delivering presentations at (1) exhibits and conferences, (2) university seminars and workshops, and (3) onsite customer visits.
  • Strengthen subscription renewal outcomes by ensuring smooth implementation support, and consistent usage of JoVE resources.
  • Influence product decisions by communicating customer feedback to sales, product, and marketing teams.


Requirements:


  • A master's degree or PhD in Life Science disciplines.
  • Experience in science communications, academic outreach or other customer-facing roles is preferred.
  • Fluent communication skills English.
  • Knowledge of education, market trends, and challenges in assigned content areas i.e. Biology, Chemistry, Medicine, Physics, Engineering, or Psychology.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with a passion for remote relationship-building.
  • Experience in networking using cold calling is preferred.


Why Join JoVE?


  • You can expect compensation packages competitively placed within the local market.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and in improving student learning in science education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Senior Oil & Gas Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Oil & Gas Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Location: Brazil (100% Remote)

Experience Level: Mid to Senior (5+ years)

Industry: Oil & Gas (Unconventional Onshore)


Role Summary

We are seeking a highly analytical Senior Regulatory & Severance Tax Accountant to join our integrated Revenue team. The primary focus of this role is to ensure the integrity of severance tax reporting for Texas and Louisiana operations. You will be responsible for identifying, troubleshooting, and resolving reporting discrepancies that lead to state-issued penalties. This is a technical, hands-on role requiring deep experience in SAP PRA (CA/VL modules) and the ability to bridge the gap between transactional data and state regulatory compliance.


Responsibilities

  • Severance Tax Compliance : Lead the end-to-end severance tax reporting process for Texas and Louisiana, ensuring all volumes and values are reported accurately and timely to the respective state agencies.
  • Error Detection & Troubleshooting : Proactively identify reporting errors by comparing state-level data against internal production and valuation records. Utilize the Valuation Control Report (VCR) and specific SAP T-Codes to diagnose root causes of variances.
  • PPA Analysis : Analyze Prior Period Adjustments (PPAs) before posting to understand the ripple effect on the General Ledger (GL), production volumes, and pricing. Ensure all adjustments are justified and accurately reflected in amended filings.
  • Penalty Reduction : Serve as the lead in reducing state-issued penalties through meticulous data validation and the timely filing of amended returns (e.g., Texas G-10/P-5, Louisiana O3).
  • Process Improvement : Troubleshoot systemic process failures and, as needed, document standardized workflows to serve as guides for broader transactional teams.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Work as one team with the Revenue Accounting group to ensure that valuation formulas and owner payment setups are consistent with regulatory requirements.



Requirements

  • Minimum of 2 years of hands-on experience in the Check Input (CA) and Valuation (VL) modules. Must have experience booking company-operated revenues and navigating sub-ledger details.
  • At least 5+ years of experience, including experience in Upstream Oil & Gas accounting, ideally focused on unconventional, onshore assets.
  • Proven experience with US (ideally Texas and Louisiana )severance tax regulations, including high-cost gas exemptions and state disposition reporting.
  • Ability to perform deep-dive reconciliations across production, revenue, and tax data sets to identify complex transactional errors.
  • Advanced/Fluent English (written and spoken) is required for coordination with US-based stakeholders.
  • A diagnostic mindset - able to look at a reporting error and trace the logic back through the SAP PRA system to the source data.
  • Capable of managing complex reporting deadlines and independent research in a fully remote environment.


Technical Requirements

  • ERP: SAP PRA (CA, VL modules), S/4HANA (preferred).
  • Reporting Tools: Advanced Excel (Power Query/Pivot), Power BI, VCR Analysis.

title: Advanced After Effects YouTube Video Editor
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Advanced After Effects YouTube Video Editor em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

⚠️ IMPORTANT: In order to apply, complete the test in After Effects (99% won't do it)! Copy and paste this link into your browser to get started:



If you just use LinkedIn's \"Easy Apply\" you will not be considered for this role.


Overview:

We are 100C ( an 8-person YouTube agency based in the United States that creates and grows YouTube channels for business owners. We need a new ADVANCED YouTube editor experienced in After Effects to take over for one of our well-established clients.


About the role:

We do all of our video editing (except for color grading and sound) in After Effects, so we’re looking for a video editor who is skilled with the software. Your role will be handling all the video editing for one of our well-established clients. Your job will include everything necessary to make professional YouTube videos, such as:

  • Color grading
  • Trimming
  • Audio post production
  • Planning the appropriate visuals for each video
  • Finding footage and imagery that match our clients’ branding
  • Using AI effectively to generate custom visuals
  • Laying out media
  • Importing and using motion graphic templates
  • Creating custom animations
  • Creating AI avatars (we'll show you how)
  • Finding and editing appropriate music
  • Finding and editing appropriate sound effects
  • Strategic editing (understanding what to cut, what to include, and how to structure it for maximum engagement)


Here is a reel of our work to give you an idea of the type of video editing we do:


Our Values:

It's important that you are in alignment with our values. If this doesn't sound like you, do NOT apply:


  • Quality First - We are a PREMIUM agency, so it's important that you're driven to constantly do your best work and take your skills to the next level. If you're just looking for a job that is easy to do and doesn't require you to think carefully about your editing, this role is NOT for you.


  • High Accountability - You want to take responsibility for your successes AND your failures. If we call you out for doing poor-quality work or delivering late, you have the emotional maturity to take ownership for it and use that to drive you to do better next time.


  • Directness - We don't beat around the bush. If you do great work, we praise you and let you know. Similarly, if something is bad, we tell you it's bad. If you can't take direct criticism, this role is NOT for you.


  • Independence - You are good at solving your own problems. We are here to help, and will go out of our way to train you and make you feel comfortable in your role, but you should be eager to own this position and do it well without us needing to constantly push you.


Additional Requirements:

Below is a list of additional requirements for the job, please read through it carefully before applying:

  • Advanced English proficiency
  • Available the equivalent of full-time (at least 40 hours per week)
  • Willing to work on weekends when necessary
  • Available to start within the next two weeks
  • Advanced After Effects skills: 3D, Rotoscoping, Masking, Motion tracking, Keying, Expressions
  • Have a “design eye”: the ability to create and follow aesthetic branding guidelines
  • Professional, meaning you deliver professional-grade work on time
  • Highly responsive


The Offer:

If hired, we will provide free copies of all the plugins we use ($500 in tools), pay for your Magnific (formerly Freepik) and Envato accounts, and teach you how to edit videos in After Effects the same way we do.


Your starting pay will be $1,500-$2,500USD per month depending on your skill level. Once you show us that you can complete the work without needing much feedback, we will increase your monthly base by $500USD. You can also earn a performance bonus of $500USD every month. So you have potential to be making as much as $3,500USD/mo within months of starting (if you're good).
